description: UiPath Orchestrator REST API integration — the RPA-domain sibling of runmyjobs_integration / controlm_integration. Each declared Release becomes a daily-partitioned Dagster asset with a retry policy. Ships with 5 ops + jobs (restart / soft-stop / kill / schedule-disable / reconcile), an external-execution monitor sensor, an inbound-trigger sensor, and an hourly reconciliation schedule. demo_mode=true simulates the full REST API lifecycle on stdout so the whole component runs end-to-end with zero external dependencies and zero UiPath licensing.

outputs.description: One daily-partitioned Dagster asset per UiPath Release + optional external source-table assets + 5 ops/jobs + 2 sensors + 1 schedule.

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Simulate the REST API on stdout (no external calls).

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.description: UiPath Orchestrator base URL (used when demo_mode=false). Cloud: https://cloud.uipath.com/{org}/{tenant}/orchestrator_ — on-prem: https://<host>

jobs.label: Jobs
jobs.description: UiPath Releases to wrap as daily-partitioned Dagster assets. Each item: {release_key, asset_name, description?, folder?, folder_id?, robot_ids?, input_arguments?, machine_group?, run_as?}.

source_tables.label: Source Tables
source_tables.description: Tables populated by UiPath processes that Dagster observes (adds to lineage). Each item: {table_name, asset_name, description?, group_name?, produced_by?}.

upstream_deps.label: Upstream Deps
upstream_deps.description: Upstream asset keys (slash-separated for nested keys) that must complete before jobs run.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Dagster asset group for the job assets.

uipath_client_id_env.label: UiPath Client ID Env Var
uipath_client_id_env.description: Env var holding the UiPath External Application client_id.

uipath_client_secret_env.label: UiPath Client Secret Env Var
uipath_client_secret_env.description: Env var holding the UiPath External Application client_secret.

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between UiPath job status polls.

poll_timeout_seconds.label: Poll Timeout Seconds
poll_timeout_seconds.description: Total seconds to wait for terminal status before failing.

partition_start_date.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start_date.description: Start date for the daily partitioned assets.

reconciliation_cron.label: Reconciliation Cron
reconciliation_cron.description: Cron for the UiPath vs Dagster state reconciliation job.

name: UiPathOrchestratorIntegration
